data.one_liner: A customizable, type-safe Flutter table widget with scrolling, sorting, and cell editing.
data.what_it_does: Provides a high-performance, type-safe data table widget for Flutter supporting synchronized scrolling, multi-state sorting, row selection, inline cell editing, column reordering and resizing, and merged rows. It is completely UI-focused and data-agnostic, relying entirely on callbacks for state mutations.
use_when: You need a feature-rich, high-performance table or grid with smooth wheel scrolling.
You want complete control over your data models and state management.
avoid_when: You need a built-in data source or pagination provider that manages state automatically.
You only require a simple standard Material DataTable without advanced desktop grid features.
strengths: Type-safe generics work with any data model class.
Rich desktop and web features like column resizing, reordering, and drag selection.
Seamless smooth wheel scrolling and deep theming integration.
weaknesses: Requires manual handling of state updates via callbacks for sorting, editing, and selection.
Can require careful handling of list identity updates to ensure proper rerendering.
data.minimal_example:
FlutterTablePlus<User>(
  columns: columns.build(),
  data: users,
  rowId: (user) => user.id,
  theme: TablePlusTheme.fromColorScheme(Theme.of(context).colorScheme),
)
